trigger.description: A daemon connection-handler panics inside dispatch (e.g. a future warm-load method hits a bounds-check failure on a corrupt mmap, an integer overflow in a scoring path, or an allocation failure under pressure). The accept loop wraps handle_connection in std::panic::catch_unwind, emits a sanitized daemon_handler_panic envelope to the client, logs the panic to stderr, and keeps serving subsequent connections rather than tearing down the accept loop.
